title: From Instructions to Intrinsic Human Values — A Survey of Alignment Goals for Big Models
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey on alignment goals for Large Language Models (LLMs), dedicating significant portions to 'Human Values', 'Social Norms & Ethics', and 'Moral Foundations Theory'. It reviews numerous benchmarks designed to evaluate moral reasoning and ethical behavior (e.g., ETHICS, Moral Stories, Scruples) and mentions surveys used to probe religious and cultural beliefs (e.g., World Values Survey, Global Attitudes Survey).
